newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fall 0.4 pct yr/yr in July.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fall 0.4 pct yr/yr in July.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, fell 0.4 percent in July from the same month last year after a year-on-year fall of 3.0 percent in June and a 1.1 percent drop in July last year, the Federal Statistics Office said.
The office said there was one more shopping day in July this year than last year.
Adjusted for inflation, the office said real retail turnover in July was 0.2 percent lower than last year, with sales of foods up 0.9 percent and clothes and textiles down by 7.0 percent.
For the first seven months of 1996, sales were 0.7 percent lower than in the same period of last year.
Adjusted for prices, the office said real sales also fell 0.7 percent in the first seven months from the same 1995 period.
